en.summary: Lou's Lagoon is a cozy exploration-and-crafting adventure from developer Tiny Roar, published by Megabit, releasing August 27, 2026 on PC, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X/S, Nintendo Switch, and Nintendo Switch 2. Players arrive on the tropical Limbo archipelago to find their Uncle Lou missing after a storm, inheriting his seaplane delivery service and setting out island to island to gather resources, rebuild communities, and piece together clues to solve the mystery of his disappearance.

guideSections.title: Seaplane Travel & Gadgets
guideSections.description: Getting around Limbo means piloting a customizable, upgradable seaplane between islands and mastering ring challenges in open skies, alongside an upgradable gadget called the Swirler 2000 used for scooping, building, gliding, and fishing.

guideSections.title: Base Building & Character Customization
guideSections.description: Beyond the central mystery, players build and decorate their own island base and fully customize their avatar's hairstyle, outfits, and accessories, with a Deluxe Edition at launch adding bubble-themed cosmetics.
